label: Under the momentary PSR the productive bridge is concurrent actualization
paraphrase: Closed result, attribution deferred: for every history, giving relation, explanation relation and reception predicate, if the momentary principle of sufficient reason holds (every received-esse thing has, at each moment of its presence, some explanation of its presence then), then the productive bridge (every such explanation comes with a giver of being at that moment) holds iff weak concurrent actualization 40a97664 holds. Forward by the derivation concurrentOfMomentaryPSR; backward because 40a97664 supplies a giver at every moment of presence whatever the explanation. So once the momentary PSR is granted, as Schmid grants it, the productive bridge says exactly what 40a97664 says; the PSR adds nothing toward 40a97664.
